quote.translation: Prince Itō's natal star is therefore Six White by both year star and month star.

regions.text: さて明治四十一年一月はまだ前年度の奪十二月に感する。それ故に明治四十年が問題である。

quote.translation: Now, January of Meiji 41 still belongs to the old twelfth month of the previous year, so that it is Meiji 40 that is in question.

regions.text: 然るに明治四十年は三碧中宮の年である。またこの蔵は丁未であるが未の十二月は三磨中宮の月である。大磯から大森は東北すなはち艮に営る。

quote.translation: Meiji 40 is a year with Three Jade in the central palace; it is also a hinoto-hitsuji year, and the old twelfth month of a hitsuji year is a month with Three Jade in the central palace.

regions.text: 然るに三磨の年三碧の月にば良には六白が來てゐる。

quote.translation: Ōmori lies north-east of Ōiso, that is, in the direction Gen, and in a year of Three Jade and a month of Three Jade, Six White has come to Gen.

regions.text: 伊藤公は年家の六白と月家の六白へ向つて韓居することによつて「本命殺」の大凶を犯したのである。

quote.translation: By moving house towards the Six White of the year star and the Six White of the month star, Prince Itō committed the great misfortune of honmeisatsu.

regions.text: しかも艮はその蔵の支たる未のある方位南西）の對中として「蔵破」と呼ばれる大凶方である。

quote.translation: Gen, moreover, lies diametrically opposite the direction (south-west) of hitsuji, the branch of that year, and so is the direction of great misfortune called saiha.

regions.text: 要するに六白本命である伊藤公が明治四十一年一月すなはち明治四十年に屬する街十二月に期やうな方位へ韓居をしたことは本命殺と厳破とを重ね犯したことになる。

quote.translation: In short, by moving house in this direction in January of Meiji 41, that is, in the old twelfth month belonging to Meiji 40, Prince Itō, whose natal star is Six White, committed honmeisatsu and saiha together.

regions.text: 同年同月槫居をするとしでも艮以外の方位を選べばよかつたのである。

quote.translation: Moving house in the same year and month, he would have been safe had he chosen any direction other than Gen.

regions.text: また艮といふ方位の具體性格は時間によつて限定されてあるのであるから、同じ艮へ終居するとしても移樽の時期を選更しさへすれば大凶に隠れなかつたのである。

quote.translation: And since the concrete character of the direction Gen is delimited by time, he could have moved to the same Gen without touching great misfortune had he only changed the time of the move.

regions.text: 方位到断の原理約矛盾と根本約迷安とは、原始的事實をアプリオリに構成しようとするところに存するのであるが空間および時間を経驗構極偶然の唯一の限定者と見

quote.translation: The contradiction in principle of directional divination, and its basic delusion, lie in its attempt to construct primordial fact a priori; yet insofar as it regards space and time as the sole delimiters of empirical positive contingency, it may also be said to touch on one side of the truth.
